title: How People Use ChatGPT in Australia: A WildChat Analysis
summary: Generative AI chatbots are increasingly embedded in everyday life, yet most large-scale studies describe global patterns. This paper presents an Australia-focused analysis of WildChat, a public dataset of real-world ChatGPT interaction logs. Using descriptive analysis and a multi-layer classification scheme, we analysed 37,845 conversations identified as Australian, examining language diversity, work relevance, interaction intent, topic distribution, turn-taking, temporal change, work activities
